duplicate_check.notes: Repository search for Wirex X-Accounts returned no canonical match before scanner review. Full-corpus duplicate scan remains mandatory.

notes: Evidence-rich CeFi interest-account candidate. Current X-Account Terms state that crypto deposited into an X-Account transfers ownership to the applicable Wirex company, may be used/held/managed at Wirex discretion, is not a bank/deposit account, and is not covered by government depositor compensation. Current terms distinguish Flexible, Plus and Fixed account liquidity/lock-up rules. Wirex's 2026 migration FAQ states that after 2026-06-30 the current Wirex App no longer supports transactions for EEA, UK and Australia and that X-Accounts are closed with funds returned to the main balance; timelines for other regions may differ. Treat the platform as regionally limited rather than globally discontinued. The contractual Wirex entity is jurisdiction-dependent and must be represented explicitly rather than collapsed into Wirex Limited; UK crypto services are currently identified as provided by Wirex Digital Services s.r.l.
